ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation and AML/CFT reporting regime); Law 1121 of 2006 (terrorism financing prevention); Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. corporate regime); Law 2195 of 2022, Articles 30-31 (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF); DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2023 (RUBF implementing and filing rules); Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolution 164 of 2021 (SIIS annual beneficiario final reporting); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular 100-000005 of 29 April 2021 (SAGRILAFT); Ley 222 de 1995 and Codigo de Comercio Articles 260-261 (control definition). The pipeline profiling key applies the FATF-aligned 25% direct/indirect ownership or control threshold as the standard UBO indicator, expanded by the SAGRILAFT and RUBF obligation to identify any natural person exercising effective control through any mechanism.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted by each foreign corporate shareholder to the Colombian incorporator and/or the proposed legal representative of the S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through the designated competent authority of the issuing State, followed by official Spanish translation; consular legalization through the Colombian consulate if the State of origin is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing (certificado de existencia y representacion) of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign commercial registry or company registrar of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified Spanish translation, or Colombian consular legalization for non-apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the corporate shareholder authorising the incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S., the capital contribution, and the appointment of representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or equivalent corporate governing body of the shareholder, certified by the foreign notary or registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified Spanish translation; consular legalization where the Apostille Convention does not apply

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised copy of passport or national identity document of each ultimate beneficial owner and of the proposed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence of the document holder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus official Spanish translation; consular legalization for non-apostille countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record certificate (antecedentes judiciales or equivalent) of the proposed legal representative(s)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Policia Nacional de Colombia (PASIV) for Colombian residents; competent criminal records authority of the country of residence for foreign representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Directly issued by the Colombian Police for domestic representatives; Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus Spanish translation for foreign-issued certificates

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Official Spanish translation of all apostilled or legalised non-Spanish originals
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified public translator recognised under Colombian law
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Translation executed by the certified translator and accepted by the Chamber of Commerce and notary; no apostille required for the translation itself

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, legal representatives, directors, main counterparties, and signatories against (i) the OFAC SDN List, (ii) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, (iii) EU targeted financial sanctions, (iv) the Colombian UIAF Listas Vinculadas and the domestic PEP registry, and (v) the Superintendencia de Sociedades SAGRILAFT screening parameters; enhanced due diligence and beneficial ownership documentation before any Government LC or SWIFT wire payment rail may be activated; ongoing transaction monitoring, ROS (reporte de operaciones sospechosas) and SOI (solicitud de operacion inmediata) obligations under Law 526 of 1999 as amended.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co), operated by Confecamaras and local Chambers of Commerce, with the homonymy certificate requested through the Chamber of Commerce of the proposed S.A.S. domicile (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota at www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name (denominacion social) must be expressed using the Spanish/Latin alphabet; Spanish orthography and diacritics follow local usage; Arabic numerals may be included; foreign words or surnames must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet; the name must include the token S.A.S. or the full words Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada; all registration documents must be written in Spanish or accompanied by an official Spanish translation accepted by the Chamber of Commerce.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RUES homonymy certificate indicates an exact match or a prohibited token, the incorporator may select an alternative name and obtain a new homonymy certificate; in case of an adverse decision by the Chamber of Commerce, the applicant must file the administrative appeal 'recurso de reposicion y en subsidio el de apelacion' before the Chamber Secretary within 10 business days of notification, citing the Codigo de Comercio Articles 112-113, Ley 1258 de 2008 and the CPACA (Ley 1437 de 2011); the Chamber has 15 business days to resolve the reposicion; the apelacion is decided by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 20 business days; if the rejection is grounded on homonymy only, the preferred practical remedy is to file a new name variant without exhausting the administrative appeal, while the reserved name will be held for 30 calendar days and may be re-filed at the date of registration of the incorporation document.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address may be used solely as the registered domicile for service of process and general correspondence; however, the ISIC 3250 business (manufacture of turbine-driven critical care invasive ventilators) mandates a physical operating establishment in Colombia with inspectable premises for INVIMA Good Manufacturing Practices (BPM) certification, sanitary registration and import/export authorisations; the virtual office may not replace the operational plant, quality-control laboratory, or bonded warehouse required for the statutory license; the Chamber of Commerce and INVIMA will require the operational address to be declared and evidenced.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Elevated – 60-75% probability of at least one unannounced on-site verification within the first 24 months of operations, combining the Camara de Comercio domicile verification programme and INVIMA GMP sanitary inspections for a medical device manufacturer with medium-risk AML/CFT classification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971) arts. 98-125 and 352-414, Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (RUES), and Ley 2069 de 2020 (entrepreneurship facilitation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed with notarially authenticated shareholder signatures); if real estate is contributed, Escritura Pública No. ___ before a Notaría Pública.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S.; capital must be fully subscribed and at least one-third paid at incorporation. No escrow account is mandated by the commercial registry; however, a fully paid-up capital of COP 200,000,000 (~USD 50,000) is recommended to evidence solvency for medical-device procurement and INVIMA inspection readiness.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY] S.A.S. - Ratification of Capital Subscription: The incorporators' subscription of 200,000 common shares, each of par value COP 1,000, fully paid and allocated, is ratified; the subscribed capital totals COP 200,000,000. Adoption of Registered Office: The registered office is fixed at Carrera 7 No. 71-21, Piso 9, Bogotá D.C., Colombia, and the President is directed to file such domicile in the commercial registry. Appointment of Officers: [NAME] is appointed Legal Representative and [NAME] is appointed Secretary-Treasurer, with the powers conferred by statute and by-laws. Execution: The Legal Representative is authorized to execute all statutory filings, open a corporate checking account, and obtain the Tax Identification Number (NIT).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute the Private Incorporation Document with Notarial Authentication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (any Colombian notary) and drafting counsel (attorney/registered public accountant)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the full by-laws, corporate purpose (manufacture of Class III invasive mechanical ventilators under ISIC 3250), capital structure, share classes, and governance rules. All shareholders must sign before a notary to obtain reconocimiento de firmas; alternatively, use certified electronic signatures accepted under Decreto 1074 de 2015. Engage a public accountant to certify the paid-up capital contribution and issue the accounting voucher for the bank deposit.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws (estatutos) and incorporation deed
Valid passports or Colombian cédulas of all shareholders
RUT (Registro Único Tributario) pre-registration of each shareholder
Bank certificate or accounting voucher evidencing paid-up capital deposit
Power of attorney if signing through representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to any clause, amend the by-laws by unanimous shareholder consent and re-execute the deed; no registry rejection occurs at this stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation with the Chamber of Commerce and Register with RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Mercantil (RUES window or online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized incorporation document via the RUES online system or in person at the Chamber. The Chamber verifies compliance with Ley 1258 de 2008, assigns the Matrícula Mercantil and provisional NIT, and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. Pay the registration fee, which is asset-based, plus the Impuesto de Registro (0.7% of subscribed capital) to the departmental treasury. Request inclusion of the CIIU code 3250 and the INVIMA pre-registration flag for medical device manufacturing.
required_dossiers: Notarized Documento Privado de Constitución
Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (FUR)
Payment receipt for registration fee and Impuesto de Registro
Acceptance letters of the legal representative and alternate representative
Anti-money-laundering sworn statement and beneficiary-ownership form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a requerimiento (inspection notice), respond with corrections within 10 business days; if the filing is rejected for defects in the by-laws, cure the defect with a private reform deed authenticated by the same notary and refile within the term indicated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Definitive NIT and Activate Tax Status with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) — RUT portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the provisional NIT assigned by RUES to complete registración in the RUT through DIAN's portal (www.dian.gov.co). Declare the corporate tax regime (régimen ordinario), the economic activity CIIU 3250, the ICP cost regime, and the profile of exporter/import operator anticipating medical-device trade. Choose the billing concept and request activation of the electronic invoicing obligation (facturación electrónica) reserved for the post-operational launch.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by Cámara de Comercio
Provisional NIT assigned
Identification documents of the legal representative
RUT form completed electronically
Sworn statement of domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN queries the tax classification, file a corrective RUT (RUT de corrección) with supporting documentation; if electronic signature activation fails, reapply with the legal representative's personal certificate at the DIAN office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register as Employer with Social Security, ARL, and Payroll System
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Social Security system operators: EPS, Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), Caja de Compensación Familiar, and PILA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the company with an ARL (e.g., SURA, Positiva, ARL Bolívar) classified under risk class V (industrial machinery) for ventilator manufacturing. Register employees with the EPS and Caja de Compensación through the PILA portal, and submit the labor contract templates to comply with Código Sustantivo del Trabajo. For foreign shareholders, complete the representative employer ID (11-digit NIT) and register the payroll-liquidation profile.
required_dossiers: NIT and company certified existence certificate
Identification of the person in charge of health & safety at work (SGSST coordinator)
Initial payroll roster (if any employees are hired at formation)
ARL class-V risk declaration and industry description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the PILA registration is rejected due to ARL mismatching, select the correct risk class and re-register; any late-free-fee error is cured by filing a novedad (amendment) retroactively within the permitted statutory term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Corporate Bank Account and Activate Operational Bookkeeping
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized financial institution (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA) and registered public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account designated for Government LC and Swift Wire payment rails, depositing the paid-up capital and obtaining the certification of capital availability. Engage a certified public accountant to authorize the opening of commercial books (libros de comercio) in the RUES book-registration platform, including the share registry book and board-minutes book.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issue date less than 30 days)
NIT and RUT
By-laws and first board resolution
Reference letters and KYC forms of the bank
Shareholders' identification and proof of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC information due to the Medium-Risk Enhanced AML tier, submit source-of-funds declarations and the corporate group chart; if the RUES book-registration is queried, rectify the minute numbering and recertify with the Chamber.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivos Médicos Clase III (Ventilador Mecánico Invasivo) and Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) — Dispositivos Médicos under Decreto 4725 de 2005 and Resolución 1484 de 2020

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and Corporación Autónoma Regional de Cundinamarca (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II — Environmental Registration and Sectoral Permits (no full EIA report required for assembly/testing facilities under this ISIC; mandatory Trámite de Permiso de Vertimientos, Emisiones Atmosféricas, and Residuos Peligrosos under Decreto 1076 de 2015, with a mandatory Diagnóstico Ambiental if the facility exceeds 30,000 m² or workforce >200).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits under Resolución 0631 de 2015 (pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 250 mg/L, COD ≤ 400 mg/L, SST ≤ 50 mg/L); air emission limits under Resolución 2254 de 2017 (PM10 ≤ 50 µg/m³ annual, VOCs controlled to 100 mg/m³ as volatile organic compounds; sanitizing-agent and ozone-sterilization by-products must meet occupational thresholds); hazardous waste management under Decreto 4741 de 2005 with manifest tracking for used lithium-ion ventilator batteries and electronic scrap.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos fire-safety certification (Certificado de Bomberos) for the production floor; structural load inspection certificate under the NSR-10 earthquake-resistant regulation; and SGSST (Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo) workplace program validated by the ARL, including medical equipment assembly line safety, electrical testing clearance, and personal protective equipment protocols for Class III life-support device manufacturing.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), the national tax and customs authority of Colombia. Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-services: sede.dian.gov.co; customs and foreign-trade platform: MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.), even when wholly owned by non-residents, obtains its statutory Tax Registration Number (NIT — Número de Identificación Tributaria) and VAT status as follows: (1) incorporate the S.A.S. by private document through the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) using the Ventanilla Única de Registro, which issues a provisional NIT; (2) after the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal is issued, complete and validate the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) before DIAN through the Sede Electrónica, expressly electing the status of Responsable de IVA (Régimen Común); (3) obtain the definitive NIT certification and activate DIAN's electronic-invoicing habilitation (authorized numbering, digital certificate, and CUFE stamping credential); (4) for export operations, enroll in the Registro de Exportadores and register the legal representative with DIAN customs; the non-resident shareholder itself does not require a separate NIT unless it renders Colombian-source services or holds a branch/permanent establishment in Colombia.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box or equivalent entity-classification election; an S.A.S. is always a juridical person taxed under the Impuesto sobre la Renta on worldwide net income at the 35% corporate rate (2024), never a pass-through. Available statutory elections relevant to this structure are: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE), an annual consolidated income tax/VAT/ICA election for entities with gross income up to 100,000 UVT; (ii) the Zona Franca election, allowing a 20% income tax rate and special customs treatment for export-manufacturing projects; (iii) the election to claim input VAT refunds as a saldo a favor on Form 140 instead of offsetting against future VAT; and (iv) treaty-based residence/PE and beneficial-ownership positions under Colombia's double-tax conventions. Hybrid mismatch rules under OECD/BEPS Action 2 are implemented, but no hybrid entity election is available under domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — Colombia's value-added tax, governed by Articles 420–521 of the Estatuto Tributario and administered by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None — there is no economic turnover threshold. Every person or entity that habitually or occasionally sells goods, renders taxable services, or imports goods into Colombian territory, including an S.A.S. exporter, must register for VAT in COP under the Régimen Común. The simplified VAT regime, which relieves certain small taxpayers from full registration and invoicing duties, is available only to natural persons with prior-year gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (services) or 4,500 UVT (goods) and is not available to an S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Venta — FEV) applies to all VAT-responsible taxpayers. Each invoice must be generated in XML, digitally stamped with the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) under DIAN's SHA-384 scheme, and transmitted to DIAN for validation — through the API/system-to-system schema before delivery to the purchaser, or through the DIAN web schema within 48 hours of issuance. Supporting electronic documents (nómina electrónica, documento soporte, debit/credit notes) and event records (receipt, rejection, acceptance) are transmitted to DIAN as well. Physical exports require a DEX (Declaración de Exportación) filed through the MUISCA customs platform. VAT returns (Form 300) are filed electronically through DIAN's Sede Electrónica on the applicable bimonthly or quarterly calendar.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible movable goods (complete ICU invasive ventilators, modules, and spare parts destined for definitive export) qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 481(1) of the Estatuto Tributario, provided: (1) the S.A.S. is registered with DIAN as a Responsable de IVA (Régimen Común); (2) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory, evidenced by an accepted definitive DEX; (3) title and risk transfer to a non-resident buyer; (4) the transaction is settled in foreign currency through an authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary and the proceeds are repatriated within the statutory deadline; and (5) the exporter maintains the statutory export documentation bundle. Certain services rendered to non-residents for use abroad and services directly linked to the exported goods may also be zero-rated under the export-of-services regime if the recipient has no permanent establishment in Colombia. The 0% rate is not an exemption from VAT; it entitles the exporter to deduct input VAT (impuestos descontables) and to recover any resulting saldo a favor through a refund application on Form 140.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DEX — Declaración de Exportación (definitive export customs declaration) transmitted via MUISCA and accepted by DIAN customs
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) evidencing the physical exit of the ventilator units from Colombian territory
Commercial invoice (Spanish/English) with full export description and FOB/incoterm value

Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas (foreign-exchange channeling certificate / inward remittance certificate) issued by the Colombian bank or authorized FX intermediary, evidencing collection of export proceeds within 180 days of shipment
Certificate of Origin (where preferential tariff treatment under a trade agreement is claimed)
Copy of the S.A.S. Registro de Exportadores enrolment and updated RUT
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DIAN determines that the asserted export was fictitious or noncompliant (false DEX, absence of physical exit, circular or unrepatriated funds, invoice cancellation without return of goods, or fabrication of customs documents), the 0% rate is retroactively reversed: VAT at 19% is assessed as though the transaction were a local taxable sale, input VAT credits are disallowed, and any refund already paid is clawed back with interest. Administrative penalties include: (1) the sanction for inexact declaration (sanción por inexactitud) of 100%–160% of the tax difference under Articles 647–648 E.T.; (2) the sanction for improper refund (devolución improcedente) of 100% of the amount recovered plus moratory interest; (3) customs fines of up to 150%–200% of the merchandise value for false or adulterated export declarations; and (4) criminal liability for customs fraud, document falsification and exchange-control fraud under the Criminal Code and Law 1762 of 2015. DIAN may audit up to five (5) prior taxable years, impose precautionary seizures on exporter bank accounts, and refer cases to the Fiscalía for criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) in coordination with the Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público; supervision and enforcement of foreign exchange regulations are delegated to the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and exercised through banking institutions licensed as authorized foreign exchange intermediaries
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a regulated rather than fully liberalized convertibility regime. Current-account transactions such as import payments, royalties, technical services, and profit remittances are generally convertible through authorized intermediaries. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, external credit, and portfolio investment, are subject to registration with Banco de la República, channeling through the Mercado Cambiario, and filing of the applicable Declaración de Cambio. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are lawful if the foreign investment is duly registered with Banco de la República, local corporate tax obligations have been settled, and the remittance is executed through an authorized intermediary; failure to maintain the foreign investment registration will trigger exchange-control penalties and bank-level blocking of the remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods export proceeds must be repatriated and channeled through Colombia's authorized foreign exchange market within the statutory period counted from the export declaration or shipment date, with a standard maximum settlement timeline of six months for goods exports under the current regulatory practice of Banco de la República. There is no partial mandatory conversion ratio: the requirement is 100% channeling and settlement of the export invoice value through a licensed local intermediary unless the exporter maintains an approved foreign-currency account with an authorized local bank. Each channeling operation requires a Declaración de Cambio identifying the export transaction by invoice and customs export declaration. Late surrender or non-channeling exposes the exporter to exchange-control fines, adverse banking classification, and audit flags in the AML transaction monitoring system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational current-account and foreign-currency settlement account for capital injection and trade disbursements
Capital escrow/operational multi-currency account with LC desk and FX hedging capabilities
Operational corporate account with integrated foreign trade and AML/KYC unit
Operational account for treasury clearing and document-based trade finance (LC and collections)
Operational account and FX derivative execution account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury clearing. The Colombian foreign exchange regime requires that all foreign-currency inflows, outflows, and conversion operations be routed through local authorized intermediaries. Offshore digital EMI platforms lacking a license from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and authorization from Banco de la República cannot legally execute Colombian Declaración de Cambio filings, cannot maintain regulated foreign exchange accounts for the S.A.S., and expose the treasury to AML sanctions-risk. EMIs may be used only as ancillary electronic payment tools outside the regulated clearing rail, never as the bank of record for export proceeds or capital injections.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A director or the legal representative of the S.A.S. must attend an initial physical interview at the chosen Colombian bank branch or, in cases of genuinely remote non-resident shareholders, a local representative bearing a notarized and apostilled power of attorney must complete the in-person interview in Bogotá or Medellín. Remote electronic signing and video interviews can supplement the file for second-level signatories after the account is active, but they do not replace the mandatory physical presence requirement for the first KYC screening of a cross-border, medium-risk, life-support manufacturing entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership opacity due to a chain of foreign companies or foundations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificado de existencia y representación legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio; full notarized corporate bylaws of the S.A.S.; updated shareholder registry book; sworn ultimate-beneficial-owner statement naming every natural person with more than 5% ownership; organizational chart with economic-control rationale; apostilled powers of attorney and certified Spanish translations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign shareholder residency in a jurisdiction classified as tax-haven, non-cooperative, or high-risk by Colombian regulators
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax residence certificate issued by the foreign shareholder's tax authority; evidence of active economic substance in the foreign jurisdiction; audited financial statements; current international sanctions/PEP screening report; sworn declaration of lawful origin of funds; bank reference letter from a Tier-1 financial institution; board resolution of the S.A.S. explaining the capital contribution's commercial rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Reported export proceeds or FX conversions that do not match underlying invoices and customs declarations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts; original supplier invoices; Colombian export declaration (Declaración de Exportación); bill of lading or airway bill; customs export validation; inbound SWIFT MT103 statements; matching Banco de la República Declaración de Cambio records; transport and insurance documentation; treasury reconciliation ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from a non-resident parent that appears inconsistent with the registered paid-in capital or minimum capital requirement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified minutes of the shareholders' meeting and board resolutions authorizing the capital increase; bank credit advice for the wire; foreign investment registration bulletin with Banco de la República; capital subscription agreement; audited balance sheet proving receipt and application of funds; purpose-code declaration filed on the Declaración de Cambio; sworn statement confirming absence of straw-man funding.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for a foreign parent's USD or EUR capital injection into CO_SAS: the parent must first obtain a formal SWIFT MT103 instruction to the beneficiary S.A.S. account at a Colombian bank authorized by Banco de la República, naming the S.A.S. tax ID (NIT), account number, and a remittance narrative clearly stating 'Aporte de capital a sociedad S.A.S. – inversión directa'. The receiving bank will apply the foreign investment concept code on the Declaración de Cambio and require the investor's foreign investment registration number or a simultaneous registration request. For capital-account inflows, the Colombian bank verifies the charter, board resolution, share-subscription agreement, and proof that the legal representative has valid KYC; funds are credited in COP or in an authorized foreign-currency account and the obligatory Declaración de Cambio is filed with Banco de la República before release to operations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements from the Colombian S.A.S. to foreign suppliers of ventilator components and technology are cleared through: (1) SWIFT MT103 cover payments for high-priority supplier remittances and royalty payments, supported by the import invoice, contract, and import declaration; (2) irrevocable documentary commercial letters of credit issued by a Colombian authorized bank under UCP600 for large capital equipment purchases, with the LC reimbursing through foreign correspondent banks; and (3) SWIFT MT202/COVER for interbank liquidity movements. All outbound disbursements must be cross-referenced against the applicable Declaración de Cambio and retained for the five-year statutory audit period.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD forward contracts executed onshore with an authorized Colombian bank or financial intermediary, supported by an underlying commercial or investment exposure and documented in the treasury hedge policy
FX swaps through authorized Colombian dealers for short-term liquidity and currency bridging between COP and USD cashflows

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) used by offshore investors to hedge Colombian peso exposure outside the regulated onshore market, subject to bank legal and tax review and prohibited from acting as substitutes for required onshore channeling
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) for converting long-term USD-denominated parent loans or LC financings into COP exposure under Banco de la República derivative-access rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31 following the prior fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of up to 20% of the registration fee, business registry temporary inactivation, possible administrative striking-off after multiple missed renewals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Unidad Administrativa Especial de Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between April and May based on NIT final digit and taxpayer category, for the immediately preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of the net tax due plus monthly default interest (1% per month), and possible criminal exposure for nonfilers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena (Sworn third-party and withholding information)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in June or July (specific date assigned via DIAN resolution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty per failure to report up to 5% of the unreported balance, plus interest; failure can suspend taxpayer electronic invoicing and certificate status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Update of Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección Ejecutiva de Aduanas (DIAN) via the RUB electronic platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the first six months of the calendar year or as provided by DIAN resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties for untimely update (up to COP 50 million), administrative difficulties in issuing certificates of good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Shareholders' Meeting Minutes Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end for assembly approval; filing by 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines per prior-codecircum; business registry holds annual renewal until financial statements are filed.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) if total gross assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 6.5 billion) or gross annual income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV; lower thresholds may apply for entities that are foreign-owned branches or subject to special surveillance.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: NIIF/IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Law 1314 of 2009 (Grupo 1 full IFRS; Grupo 2 IFRS for SMEs).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must annually confirm and update beneficial ownership data (Directors with ≥10% shareholding, ultimate natural persons, any controlling positions) via the DIAN RUB platform. Any share transfer triggering ownership change must be reported in the same annual confirmation cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives (Libro de Registro de Representantes Legales)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y/o Junta Directiva)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (fiscal year 2025; general rate applicable to S.A.S..)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for medical device manufacturers; general 35% CIT. Potential preferential reductions: 20% Zona Franca rate if an industrial user permit is obtained; 160%/110% deduction for certain R&D/SDI expenditures; 4.5% discount for hiring young workers; no other local incentives.
